name: Dishwasher
summary: Built-in appliance that washes dishes with hot water and detergent.
education: Most dishwashers run for 10-15 years. Filters at the base trap food and gradually clog spray arms. Door gaskets harden and leak. A monthly cleaning cycle and a yearly hose check go a long way.

suggested_photos.prompt: Model and serial label (often on the side of the door when open)

maintenance.why: Trapped food rots and recirculates onto your dishes.

maintenance.action: Run a cleaning cycle (vinegar or dishwasher cleaner)
maintenance.why: Clears mineral buildup from spray arms and pump.

maintenance.action: Inspect door gasket and supply hose
maintenance.why: Slow leaks at the connection or gasket cause cabinet rot before you notice.
